name: comp-331
blurb: Modal for updating profile with name, bio, website, and image uploads.
description: A scrollable shadcn Dialog with background and avatar image uploads, name fields, website, bio with character counter.
use_when: Allowing users to update their profile information including photos, name, website, and biography.
avoid_when: For very large files or complex image cropping — this form handles basic file uploads and previews.
a11y: Form fields are labeled; bio has aria-describedby for character count; aria-live=polite for live updates; image buttons have aria-labels.
